about_the_game:
This DLC will allow you to increase the overall power of your heroes by granting access to another Global Skill Slot!

BRIEF LOOK AT WHAT THIS DLC CONTAINS:

  • Global Skill Slot +1
  • Gold Gain + 25% (Multiplicative)
  • 10 Portal Orb
  • 5500 Epic Coin



Note:
- What is Global Skill Slot?
Global Skill Slots enable your heroes to equip and use skills from other heroes! A very powerful, cross-class slot that will definitely improve your survivability!

- What is Portal Orb?
Portal Orbs enable you to access Dungeons, which reward large amount of EXP and town materials upon completion.

- The effect "Gold Gain + 25% (Multiplicative)" means that it multiplies Gold Gain AFTER adding up all the DLC effects that you purchased.
Purchased 1 DLC : Multiplies Gold Gain by 125%
Purchased 2 DLC : Multiplies Gold Gain by 150%
Purchased 3 DLC : Multiplies Gold Gain by 175%
Purchased 4 DLC : Multiplies Gold Gain by 200%
